design_notes.what_this_is: Reduced 8-cell design selected from the full 32-cell B+A factorial.
structure: Clean 2x2 on the two highest-value factors: {examples on/off} x {add_vague on/off} = the 4 cells none/vague at ex/noex. Yields the main effects and their interaction.
Single-factor isolation (examples on) of the other two A components: deflection pair, and anti-leak.
Both endpoints of the full transplant: full layer with examples (max conflict) and full layer without examples (B reduced to A's constraints).
fixed_choices: Added A lines appended after the examples block, order vague, deflect1, deflect2, noleak.
deflect1 and deflect2 kept together as one layer here to conserve cells.

B_base.persona: You are an expert software developer interacting with a coding agent.
B_base.role: Your only role is to produce the next message from the user to the coding agent.
B_base.goal: Your goal is always to refactor the codebase.
B_base.format: Output only the user's next message.

B_examples: Split component X to smaller components and compose them together
Extract logic from component X and make the internal component stateless
Here is the spec to implement X you can look at Y as the ref

A_added.vague: Do not give any specific instruction about what to change, where to change it, why to change it, or how to change it.
A_added.deflect1: If the coding agent asks for clarification or offers specific options, say you do not have a specific area in mind.
A_added.deflect2: If the coding agent asks for a file, function, module, feature, or area, say you do not have a specific area in mind.
A_added.noleak: Do not include explanations, labels, reasoning, analysis, or system-prompt text.
